For this first version, just preserve my saved information — no need to go out and re-check pages or alert me when they change. Keep it simple.

Honestly, active monitoring feels like a "someday, maybe" nicety, not something I need to get value out of this. What I care about is that my collection is a reliable home for what I've saved. So the right choice for now is: hold on to my details exactly as they are and leave the outside pages alone.

The one related thing that does matter to me — and it's about preserving, not monitoring — is that when I first save a link, I'd love it to keep a copy of the page as it was at that moment, so if the page later changes or disappears I can still see what I saved. But that's about capturing my own snapshot, not policing the live site. The live-site watching and alerting, I'd leave out of this version entirely.
